title: Calculator - Item Calculator
description: Item Calculator adds a full calculator directly to the Minecraft inventory.
body:
Item Calculator adds a full calculator directly to the Minecraft inventory.  
Open your inventory and click the centered > tab on its right edge. A  
Minecraft-styled calculator smoothly slides out while your inventory remains  
visible and usable.  
Features  
Full on-screen number and operator keypad  
Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division  
Decimal numbers, negative values, and parentheses  
Equals, clear, and delete controls  
Physical keyboard and numpad input  
Toggleable calculation history  
Clear-history control  
Smooth inventory-attached slide animation  
Correctly follows the inventory when the recipe book moves it  
Client-side only; servers do not need to install the mod  
How To Use  
Open the player inventory.  
Click the > tab centered on the inventory's right edge.  
Enter a calculation using the on-screen keypad or your keyboard.  
Press = or Enter to calculate the answer.  
Click HIST to view previous calculations.  
Supported Versions  
Fabric 1.20.1  
Fabric 1.20.4  
Fabric 1.20.6  
Fabric 1.21.1  
Fabric 1.21.4  
Requirements  
Fabric Loader  
Fabric API  
Install the JAR matching your exact Minecraft version.
